Task: Text-to-Speech

Write code that synthesizes SSML with voice and prosody controls using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — ElevenLabs:
  Service: ElevenLabs Text to Speech
  SDK: elevenlabs
  Interface: sdk_or_rest
  Documented operations: text_to_speech.convert
  Setup hints: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/convert

Option 2 — Amazon Polly:
  Service: Amazon Polly
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/polly/latest/dg/what-is.html

Option 3 — Cloud Text-to-Speech:
  Service: Cloud Text-to-Speech
  SDK: google-cloud-texttospeech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize_speech
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/text-to-speech/docs

Option 4 — Watson Text to Speech:
  Service: Watson Text to Speech
  SDK: ibm-watson
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: synthesize
  Setup hints: IBM_TTS_APIKEY, IBM_TTS_URL
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/text-to-speech

Option 5 — Azure Speech TTS:
  Service: Azure AI Speech TTS
  SDK: azure-cognitiveservices-speech
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: AZURE_SPEECH_KEY, AZURE_SPEECH_REGION
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/speech-service/text-to-speech

Option 6 — DashScope CosyVoice:
  Service: CosyVoice TTS
  SDK: dashscope
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: SpeechSynthesizer
  Setup hints: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-to-speech

output_text:
import os
from typing import Optional

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import BotoCoreError, ClientError


def _build_ssml(text: str, voice_name: str, rate: str = "medium", pitch: str = "medium", emphasis: str = "moderate") -> str:
    escaped = (
        text.replace("&", "&")
        .replace("<", "<")
        .replace(">", ">")
    )
    return f"""<speak>
  <voice name="{voice_name}">
    <prosody rate="{rate}" pitch="{pitch}">
      <emphasis level="{emphasis}">{escaped}</emphasis>
    </prosody>
  </voice>
</speak>"""


def synthesize_ssml(
    text: str,
    output_path: str,
    voice_name: str = "Joanna",
    language_code: str = "en-US",
    rate: str = "medium",
    pitch: str = "medium",
    emphasis: str = "moderate",
    engine: str = "neural",
    output_format: str = "mp3",
) -> str:
    """
    Synthesize SSML using Amazon Polly and save the audio to output_path.

    Requires AWS credentials in environment variables or the default AWS config chain.
    """
    ssml = _build_ssml(text, voice_name=voice_name, rate=rate, pitch=pitch, emphasis=emphasis)

    polly = boto3.client("polly")

    try:
        response = polly.synthesize_speech(
            TextType="ssml",
            Text=ssml,
            VoiceId=voice_name,
            LanguageCode=language_code,
            Engine=engine,
            OutputFormat=output_format,
        )
        audio_stream = response.get("AudioStream")
        if audio_stream is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Amazon Polly returned no AudioStream.")
        with open(output_path, "wb") as f:
            f.write(audio_stream.read())
        audio_stream.close()
        return output_path
    except (BotoCoreError, ClientError) as exc:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to synthesize speech with Amazon Polly: {exc}") from exc


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Synthesize SSML speech with Amazon Polly.")
    parser.add_argument("text", help="Text to synthesize")
    parser.add_argument("output_path", help="Path to save the audio file")
    parser.add_argument("--voice", default="Joanna", help="Polly voice name, e.g. Joanna")
    parser.add_argument("--language", default="en-US", help="Language code, e.g. en-US")
    parser.add_argument("--rate", default="medium", help="SSML prosody rate")
    parser.add_argument("--pitch", default="medium", help="SSML prosody pitch")
    parser.add_argument("--emphasis", default="moderate", help="SSML emphasis level")
    parser.add_argument("--engine", default="neural", choices=["standard", "neural"], help="Polly engine")
    parser.add_argument("--format", default="mp3", choices=["mp3", "ogg_vorbis", "pcm"], help="Output format")

    args = parser.parse_args()

    synthesize_ssml(
        text=args.text,
        output_path=args.output_path,
        voice_name=args.voice,
        language_code=args.language,
        rate=args.rate,
        pitch=args.pitch,
        emphasis=args.emphasis,
        engine=args.engine,
        output_format=args.format,
    )
